item.title: Sold-Out Strings & Wind Concert Celebrates Hindustani Classical Music in Mumbai
item.description: Mumbai’s sold-out Strings & Wind concert at the NCPA featured a rare collaboration between Ustad Shujaat Husain Khan and Pandit Rakesh Chaurasia.

item.title: India’s Top Film Festivals to Watch Out for in 2026
item.description: India’s film festivals in 2026 reflect a growing appetite for global, independent and conversation-driven cinema.

item.title: Chhattisgarh CM Lays Foundation Stone for Chitrotpala International Film City in Naya Raipur
item.description: Chhattisgarh CM Vishnudev Sai laid the foundation stone for the 95-acre Chitrotpala International Film City in Naya Raipur, envisioned as a world-class hub for cinema and culture.

item.title: Blackboard Communications Curates Founders Day Experience for General Catalyst in Bengaluru
item.description: General Catalyst brought together its founder community in Bengaluru for an intimate Founders Day, curated end-to-end by Blackboard Communications.

item.title: Disrupting the Ordinary: Sheen Kundu’s Global Take on Event Excellence
item.description: Sheen Kundu, AVP – Events at Ebix Travels Pvt. Ltd, is redefining experiential events. With a decade of global experience, she crafts moments that resonate, blending creativity, precision, and innovation.

item.title: Sheraton Grand Palace Indore Appoints Nimish Pitale as Director of Sales and Marketing
item.description: Sheraton Grand Palace Indore has appointed Nimish Pitale as Director of Sales and Marketing to lead its commercial strategy and revenue growth.

item.title: Rohtak Royals Onboard Multiple Brands for Inaugural Kabaddi Champions League
item.description: Rohtak Royals have onboarded ixigo, John Players, Campus Activewear, MuscleBlaze and Knack Pro Sports as sponsors ahead of their debut campaign in the inaugural Kabaddi Champions League.

item.title: Jazz India Circuit Returns with 9th Edition This February
item.description: The Jazz India Circuit returns this February with its 9th edition, with a Mumbai concert at the Royal Opera House on 5 February 2026.

item.title: Catering Collective appoints Aloka Shhejwadkarr as Director of Sales (Celebrations)
item.description: Catering Collective has appointed Aloka Shhejwadkarr as Director of Sales (Celebrations), strengthening its leadership in India’s luxury celebrations catering space.

item.title: Hyatt Place Butwal Emerges as a New Destination Wedding Hotspot for Indian Couples
item.description: Hyatt Place Butwal is gaining popularity among Indian couples as a convenient cross-border destination wedding venue, offering spacious event facilities, international hospitality, and a scenic Himalayan setting.
